visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Property Syntax Does Not Fill the Map
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The map should hold one entry and print 30 1, but it prints undefined 0.

solution.explanation: ages["Asha"] = 30 adds an ordinary property to the Map object, not an entry in the map's storage, so get and size cannot see it. Entries must be added with set.
